game: Diablo II: Resurrected 3.3.93847, Reign of the Warlock
description: Mean hostile monsters and packs per game, by level and difficulty. Every room of every level is loaded and populated by the game's own code; quest events (seal bosses, Diablo, Baal waves, Ancients, Nihlathak, the Gidbinn pack) are included. NPCs, allies, neutrals, critters and neverCount units are left out. total and types count monsters. A pack is what one spawn made together (a group and its party, a boss and its minions, a champion pack, a preset); packs are keyed by their primary monster (MonStats Id, superuniques by name), its quality and monster level (the level the game gave the unit), and give the mean packs per game and the mean monsters per game in them besides the primary, by MonStats Id, quality and monster level; a level's total is its packs plus their members. areaLevel is Levels.txt MonLvlEx. area is measured in subtiles (a tile is 5x5) from the rooms' collision grids, mean per game: walkable means no wall, no-player or blank bit; spawnCells are the 3x3-subtile cells that random spawns roll MonDen on.
